title: Swamp Cabin at Dusk
description: A weathered wooden cabin built around a massive ancient tree stands in a flooded swamp, its windows glowing with warm light. Two small boats float in the foreground among cypress knees and purple flowers, while white birds perch on branches and a water tower rises in the background under a purple and pink twilight sky.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a rustic wooden cabin built into the massive roots and trunk of an ancient cypress tree standing in a flooded Louisiana swamp at twilight. Warm light glows from the windows, two wooden boats float nearby, purple irises grow from the water, white birds perch on branches, moss hangs from the trees, and a water tower is visible in the distant background, painterly style with rich atmospheric colors.
